request.raw_text: Add third rotor blade to the assembly. It should have the same design as the other two. Radii should applied on all four long edges of the blade. Adjust central portion of all three blades so that there is a space for a new blade - reduce thickness of the central portion to cca 0,42mm. New blade should go through the center of the stack.
reference_geometry_words: all four long edges of the blade
central portion of all three blades
functional_intention_words: same design as the other two
go through the center of the stack

aim.primary_aim: Produce a three-blade rotor assembly in which the added blade matches the existing blade design, has radiused long edges, and passes through the stack center using reduced-thickness central portions.

functional_design_intentions.name: Third-blade integration
functional_design_intentions.description: Add a third rotor blade to the assembly while maintaining the design established by the other two blades.

functional_design_intentions.name: Central accommodation space
functional_design_intentions.description: Reduce the central portions of all three blades to approximately 0.42 mm thickness so that space is available for the new blade.

functional_design_intentions.name: Centered stack passage
functional_design_intentions.description: Arrange the new blade so that it passes through the center of the blade stack.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: third rotor blade in the assembly
four long edges of the blade

required_relationships.reference: all four long edges of the blade

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: central portions of all three blades

required_relationships.reference: the central portion of each of the three blades

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: overall blade design established by the two existing rotor blades
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the established blade design in the new third blade except for the explicitly required central-portion adjustment and long-edge radii.
Preserve geometry not required to change for adding, radiusing, centrally thinning, and positioning the third blade.

geometry.description: The assembly contains three rotor blades, including one added blade with the same design as the other two and extending through the center of the stack.
Radii are present on all four long edges of the blade.

relationships.reference: all four long edges of the blade

geometry.description: The central portion of each of the three blades has an approximate thickness of 0.42 mm, providing space for the new blade.

functions.name: Accommodate third rotor blade
functions.description: The three central blade portions provide the space required to incorporate the third blade into the stack.

functions.name: Maintain blade design consistency
functions.description: The new blade retains the same blade design as the other two while satisfying the specified long-edge radius requirement.

behaviors.name: Centered blade passage
behaviors.description: The reduced central portions allow the new blade to pass through the center of the stack.

validation_criteria.description: The final assembly contains three rotor blades.
The added third rotor blade has the same design as the other two blades, apart from explicitly requested changes.
All four long edges of the applicable blade are radiused.
The central portion of each of the three blades has an approximate thickness of 0.42 mm.
The new blade passes through the center of the stack.
The adjusted central portions provide space for the new third blade.
The new blade can occupy a centered passage through the stack enabled by the reduced central portions.
Non-targeted assembly geometry and the established overall blade design remain preserved.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request does not specify the numerical radius to apply to the long edges.
candidate_interpretations: Match an existing long-edge radius present on the other blades.
Use a radius value to be supplied by the engineer.

unresolved_requirements.description: The phrase 'the blade' does not state unambiguously whether the four long-edge radii apply only to the new blade or to all three blades.
candidate_interpretations: Apply radii to all four long edges of the new third blade.
Apply radii to all four long edges of each of the three blades.

unresolved_requirements.description: The approximate requirement 'cca 0.42 mm' does not specify an acceptable thickness tolerance.
candidate_interpretations: Treat 0.42 mm as the nominal central-portion thickness.
Apply an engineer-specified tolerance around 0.42 mm.

unresolved_requirements.description: No exact assembly, blade, central-section, or stack identifiers are supplied.
candidate_interpretations: Resolve the two existing rotor blades and their shared stack from model context.
Request explicit model identifiers if the assembly contains multiple possible blade stacks.
